name: Esat Zorkirişçi
bio:
Esat Zorkirişçi completed his education through high school in Gaziantep and graduated from Celal Bayar University with a degree in Business Administration. After working in various areas of the finance sector, he discovered creative drama, which became a companion on his lifelong journey of learning. While searching for an answer to the question “How can I share what I have learned with children?”, he began writing children’s books. During this period, he won second prize in the Picture Book Competition at the 23rd Tudem Literature Awards.

After years of working as a white-collar professional in the corporate world, he decided to fold his white collar into a paper boat and set sail through the world of imagination with children. He now leads workshops in schools, museums, and outdoor spaces with the children he affectionately calls his “playmates.”
